dataset.name: CheckMate nivolumab-treated advanced ccRCC cohort (2020)
dataset.description: Independent advanced clear-cell renal-cell carcinoma cohort with pretreatment bulk tumor RNA sequencing and individual progression-free and overall-survival follow-up during nivolumab therapy.
dataset.cohort_context: The published CheckMate-009, CheckMate-010 and CheckMate-025 biomarker resource contains 311 expression-linked tumors. TRACE Explorer prespecifies the 181 patients treated with nivolumab and excludes the 130-patient everolimus arm so treatment assignment is not mixed into a prognostic survival analysis.

metadata.source_program: CheckMate-009, CheckMate-010 and CheckMate-025 prospective clinical trials
metadata.source_data_system: PMC author manuscript and public article supplements
metadata.library_method: Pretreatment primary or metastatic ccRCC bulk RNA sequencing; CheckMate-010 and CheckMate-025 reads were aligned with STAR and quantified with RSEM, while the previously published CheckMate-009 TPM matrix was retained
metadata.treatment_context: Advanced clear-cell renal-cell carcinoma treated with nivolumab
metadata.endpoint_context: Trial-defined progression-free and overall survival after anti-PD-1 therapy
metadata.sample_selection_note: The clinical workbook contains 1,006 trial records. Eligibility is fixed before endpoint analysis to nivolumab treatment and a non-missing RNA_ID. All 181 resulting identifiers occur exactly once in the 311-column normalized expression workbook and map to 181 unique subjects: 16 from CheckMate-009, 45 from CheckMate-010 and 120 from the nivolumab arm of CheckMate-025.
metadata.expression_processing_note: The authors filtered low-quality libraries, upper-quartile normalized TPM to 1,000, applied log2 transformation, corrected four sequencing batches with ComBat and added a constant of 21 to remove correction-induced negative values. TRACE Explorer preserves that supplied scale unchanged.
metadata.expression_curation_note: The source workbook contains 43,893 expression rows. Twenty-eight feature cells were converted by Excel into date values, including ambiguous duplicate March and September labels. They are excluded rather than guessed, leaving 43,865 exact and case-insensitively unique feature labels.
metadata.endpoint_caveat: The source columns OS_CNSR and PFS_CNSR encode 1 as an observed event and 0 as censoring. The retained nivolumab cohort contains 123 OS events and 58 OS-censored observations, and 159 PFS events and 22 PFS-censored observations.
metadata.overlap_note: These prospective CheckMate trials are independent of TCGA-KIRC and do not overlap the active RECA-EU, CPTAC, IMmotion150, FUSCC or Dana-Farber epigenomic-atlas releases.
metadata.license_note: The author manuscript states that the clinical table and normalized RNA-seq matrix are included as public supplementary data. The files are downloaded and transformed in place with pinned hashes; source and derived expression redistribution remains disabled under PMC and Springer Nature terms.

samples.sample_role: Pretreatment primary or metastatic advanced ccRCC tumor used for bulk RNA sequencing

expression.label: Source-provided upper-quartile normalized log2 ComBat expression
expression.source_unit: UQ-normalized log2 TPM, ComBat-corrected and shifted +21
expression.analysis_unit: Source-provided upper-quartile normalized log2 ComBat expression
expression.mapping_source: Gene labels supplied in the pinned CheckMate Supplementary Table 4 workbook
expression.duplicate_feature_rationale: Twenty-eight date-formatted feature cells are excluded because their original gene labels cannot be recovered unambiguously. The remaining 43,865 labels are exact and case-insensitively unique, so no aggregation or online remapping is applied.
expression.scale_note: The authors' normalized, batch-corrected matrix is preserved exactly after exclusion of unrecoverable date-formatted feature labels. Values are intended only for within-cohort analysis.

endpoints.label: Overall survival during nivolumab therapy
endpoints.event_definition: Death from any cause during trial follow-up

endpoints.label: Progression-free survival during nivolumab therapy
endpoints.event_definition: Progression or death during trial follow-up
